original_measured_producer_course_metada.coverage_note: Partial course: 57 lessons, 470 graded exercises with complete solutions and 69 diagrams. 87 source items proved, 18 completed corrections and 7 mixed reviews under explicit prerequisites; 1 assigned source items remain open. The supported standard Borel groupoid source review is complete. Final full-course prerequisite/source validation remains in progress. Independent review has not been completed.
original_measured_producer_course_metada.prerequisite_validation_note: The course has 57 lessons and 470 complete worked solutions at their stated prerequisites. Section1A proves the compact-normal centralizer/component theorem; Section1B proves five Lie-approximation reductions; Section1C constructs the full locally compact radical assuming S2. Sections1D–1E construct compact conjugation from the complete root-production provider and prove the closed split rank-one subgroup theorem for nonlinear groups and infinite centres, with five complete diagnostic solutions. General metrizable Gleason–Yamabe remains an explicit input pending integration and review. Prescribed two-ceiling tiling, unrestricted Connes two-copy existence. Internal workflow reviews do not constitute external independent approval.
